Delivery Model

Structured execution from spec to release.

PHASE 01

Scope

We define constraints, users, and success metrics before a single screen is drawn. No ambiguity, no scope creep.

PHASE 02

Design

Architecture, data models, and a sequenced implementation plan — reviewed and signed off before build.

PHASE 03

Build

Controlled milestones with hard acceptance criteria on each delivery. You see progress weekly, not surprises at the end.

PHASE 04

Launch

Rollout, monitoring, handover documentation, and a post-launch iteration cycle tuned to real usage.
